LanguageData.FCP_SelectSynthTierDesc: Choose which synth line to gestate. Requires the matching research and enough raw materials staged nearby.
LanguageData.FCP_SynthPodUpdatingProgramming_Start: {0}'s body has finished growing, but the Institute won't release it until its personality matrix finishes uploading. Expect another day before it's ready.
LanguageData.FCP_SynthPodNothingResearched: No synth tiers have been researched yet.
LanguageData.FCP_Institute_SynthReplacement_Text: {0} came back from the trip with the same face, the same voice, and the same habits as before. There is nothing here to point to. That is exactly how the Institute prefers it.
LanguageData.FCP_InstituteRelocation_Text: {0} has been discreetly approached by {1} with a one-time offer: step away from the colony for good and take up a post underground. In return, a shipment of equipment will be delivered and {1} will look more favorably on your colony. {0} would not be coming back.
LanguageData.FCP_InstituteRelocation_ConfirmText: {0} was collected without incident. A shipment arrived shortly after, exactly as promised.
